title: Joe Armstrong - Keynote: The Forgotten Ideas in Computer Science - Code BEAM SF 2018
summary: Erlang co-creator Joe Armstrong's Code BEAM SF 2018 keynote revisits good ideas from the history of computing that were dropped, and asks which should be revived. It also touches on Erlang and Elixir.
why: HN people recommend it as a reading list of historical CS ideas worth knowing, and as a favorite among Armstrong's talks, especially after his death.

quote.text: Ted has a knack for reframing things in ways that make the arbitrariness of certain historical decisions clear
